records.label: spacr.restart_state.command#1
records.source: A frozen application restarts its bundled executable directly, without Python interpreter flags. An unfrozen installation uses the active Python interpreter and the explicit :mod:`spacr.qt` entry point. Both routes return to the same GUI without depending on an executable found through ``PATH``.
